title: erigeron hungaricus
intro: Erigeron hungaricus, commonly known as Hungarian fleabane, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral effects. The plant's therapeutic actions include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Erigeron hungaricus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
